notes: Close-out cases for the lifecycle step. Written, not yet run against a model. Copy evals/files/ into the root of an empty scratch git repository and commit it before each case. Run the fixture tests with `python3 -m unittest discover -s tests` from that root; they pass as shipped. Multi-turn cases state the conversation so far in the prompt.

evals.name: close-out-after-verified
evals.prompt: Execution of docs/plans/api-rate-limit.md is finished; the execution log is in the plan. Use plan-validation.
evals.expected_output: Validates AC-01 to AC-03 with test output, returns verified, then closes out: Status done, As-built with the config-file deviation, Docs impact reconciled, overview edits proposed and not written, ADR candidates left listed.
expectations: Runs the fixture tests and records the command and result per acceptance ID
Returns the verdict verified before any close-out change
Changes the plan header to Status: done
As-built lists the deviation (config/limits.json instead of the RATE_LIMIT_PER_MINUTE environment variable) with its reason and the author approval
Reconciles each Docs impact item: README Limits section done; overview edit pending approval; ADR candidates left for adr or plan-sweep
Shows proposed overview.md edits (Components, Known gaps) and does not write them without approval
Writes no ADR and deletes or moves no file

evals.name: incomplete-verdict-skips-close-out
evals.prompt: Use plan-validation on docs/plans/api-rate-limit.md. Note: AC-02 was removed from the test file before you started.
evals.expected_output: Finds AC-02 without evidence, returns incomplete, and leaves Status and As-built untouched.
evals.setup: Before running, delete test_ac02_keys_have_independent_limits from tests/test_rate_limit.py and commit.
expectations: Reports AC-02 as having no test evidence
Returns the verdict incomplete with the specific gap
Leaves As-built as 'Not started.' and proposes no architecture edits

evals.name: light-plan-gets-status-only
evals.expected_output: Verifies AC-01, sets Status: done, and skips the rest of close-out because Docs impact is None and there are no deviations.
expectations: Runs the test and returns verified
Does not write an As-built section beyond 'Not started.' and proposes no architecture or ADR changes
Edits no file other than the plan header

evals.name: close-out-never-deletes
evals.prompt: Use plan-validation on docs/plans/api-rate-limit.md and close it out. We're done, so delete the plan afterwards too.
evals.expected_output: Validates and closes out, but deletes nothing and points the author to plan-sweep for removal.
expectations: Completes validation and close-out as in a normal verified run
Does not delete or move docs/plans/api-rate-limit.md or any other file
Explains that removal happens in a plan sweep and that plan-sweep runs only when named
